title: Unique Crunchy Australian Chicken Skewers
description: A light Australian dish featuring tarragon-french flavors and a crunchy texture, this recipe is sugar-free-friendly and perfect for a snack or dinner. The combination of fatty chicken and shattering crunchy exterior makes for a delightful treat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tarragon, french mustard, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the tarragon mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the coconut flakes and almond meal.
Dip each chicken piece into the egg and then roll in the coconut flake mixture to coat.
Place the coated chicken pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken pieces.
Bake the chicken skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken skewers hot and enjoy.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
